utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the 31st of August. Can you all hear me, or am I talking to myself again?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: We can hear you. Bank holiday crew, living the dream.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Well, there's a birthday cake in the office, so it's not entirely bleak.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Saw that. Someone's made a fairly engineering-sized cut in it already.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Also, whose new car is that in the car park? Looks far too clean to belong here.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Not mine. Mine's the one with half the county on the wheel arches.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And after the charity bake sale on Friday, I think we've all had enough sugar to run a shift without the CHP.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Wouldn't fancy guaranteeing the output, mind.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes a catering meeting. What's finished, then what's actually ours to do?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, so I finished the repair on the GT2 bearing last night. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. The repair itself is closed, then?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep, finished. Not another repair job for today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marcus Hale, can you sort the permit to work and isolation for the GT2 bearing? That's the separate bit I need covered.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the GT2 bearing.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Right, just keeping those two things distinct. My repair update wasn't me saying the permit side was sorted.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Understood. Permit to work and isolation are with me; not repeating your repair.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Other completed bits?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I already swapped the filter on the Gas Turbine 1 yesterday. That's off the list.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, heard that on handover. No outstanding filter change there.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And I tested the boiler feed pump yesterday and it's all fine now. That's a completed one as well.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Good. Nice to have a few things in the done column for once.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Just an observation from nights: noticed the fire alarm panel was running a bit warm, but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Settled down during nights, you mean? Not still doing it?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, settled down then. Nothing ongoing in that report; I'm not raising another job.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, observation noted, not an action coming out of this stand-up.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Other thing from me, I'm still waiting on parts for the boiler safety valve. Nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, those parts aren't here. No change to that blocker.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, boiler safety valve stays blocked. Not putting it down as work somebody can get on with today.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: On the live stuff, the guarding on the line 3 needs checking. That's the one I wanted to bring up first.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I'll check the guarding on the line 3. That one's safety critical, straight away.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Hannah. Agreed, straight away for the guarding on the line 3.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, that's not one for the bottom of the list.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: No, absolutely. That's my first one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And where are we with the line 2 robot?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Still got the jam. It needs clearing, and the sensors need checking as part of that. Not just the jam on its own.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the line 2 robot this morning. Fairly important, that one.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Hannah, both parts of that this morning. Fairly important, with the safety-critical guarding still first.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, that's the order I've got. Guarding straight away, then the line 2 robot this morning.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Sorry, I talked over the end there—Teams did its little underwater thing. You said sensors as well?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: She did, yeah. Clear the jam and check the sensors. Both.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Next one is the sensors on the dryer.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I'll recalibrate the sensors on the dryer by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Marcus. Recalibrate the sensors on the dryer, by the end of the week. Agreed.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, that's with me.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: End of the week, got it. Not putting that into the straight-away bucket with the guarding.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: And the seals on the MV01—is that still one we're agreeing here?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll replace the seals on the MV01 by the 28th. Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Just flagging the date wording: we're on the 31st, so the 28th is already behind us.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, that's the deadline on it. I'm not moving it to a different date here. I'll take the seal replacement, still normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Marcus Hale owns replacing the seals on the MV01. Keep 'by the 28th' as the stated deadline and normal priority; we're not quietly rewriting either.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, so that date query isn't us suddenly calling it an urgent job.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Exactly. Normal priority for the MV01 seals.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Quick read-back, then. Marcus Hale, permit to work and isolation for the GT2 bearing, separate from the repair Priya's already finished.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yes, accepted. That's mine.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Hannah, guarding on the line 3 straight away, safety critical; clear the jam and check the sensors on the line 2 robot this morning, fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, both agreed. And the boiler safety valve is still blocked, not a third live job.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marcus, the sensors on the dryer by the end of the week. We've already pinned down the MV01 wording.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: All matches what I've got. Completed items and the blocked valve are separate from those actions.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Nothing else from electrical. And yes, you all sound normal again now.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's generous. Audio might be normal.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that'll do us. Thanks, everyone. Hopefully there's still some birthday cake left when we get off Teams.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Depends how long your goodbye takes. Cheers, all.
